checksBeforeRetaining: every round trip in the report has its request and response file in the capture folder
each captured file's sha256 and byte count match the report
no captured request holds an invented value
no retained file holds an API key shape
the capture folder holds nothing the report does not list
notRetained: the run's three gateway logs: the check writes them to a temporary folder and does not keep them, so they cannot be retained after the fact
claim: These are the report and the exact request and response bytes of one live run, as the run's own report recorded them. Retention pins the bytes; it does not re-run the check or widen what the run covered.
